dialog: Four thousand years of Chinese history!
This will clean you right up!
Let's send that arm of yours flying/ shall we?
Let's see here. How to launch the arm...
I need to call it out alongside—oops. Too late/ I guess.
I'll try doing it like Marisa...
A new magic trick with no hidden strings...
I'll try to do this like my sister would...
I just need to shout it out/ right?
Time for you to go to sleep.
Umm/ what was this attack's name again...?
Right in the nick of time...
A knuckle to turn the tables!
I'll do this like I usually do...
Focus your mind on your fist...
And punch with all your might!
I don't much like loud noises.
I've been saving this for you.
The wonderful ninja technique: the flying fist jutsu!
Don't let them get away/ Hisoutensoku!
Yes/ they will do for a target.
Yeah/ let's make a show of this!
A fist of iron/ shooting through the air~
Bad children need to be punished!
Bad children need to be punished!
You should be close enough to land a hit.
It's so much fun to watch/ no matter how many times I see it.
I suppose it's technically a fellow doll...
...Ahem. I have to say this clearly...
I know a thing or two about robots!
These are true fangs of steel!
Let me snap a few good ones/ alright?
Let me snap a few good ones/ alright?
This is how strong giant robots are!
Now seems like a good time!
I'm gonna do it! Hope that's okay!
I'm kind of against this/ but...
It can shoot it's hand off? I'm green with envy...
Oh/ just fire already/ would you?!
Show me a good one/ you hear?
I'll tell you how the enemy will move.
Rocket Iron Drill Brea— Ow! I bit my tongue!
A nice/ big punch/ if you please.
Don't tell me this attack is more shocking than me...
I have to yell nice and loud!
I'm close enough to cheer it on from here...
Heh heh. Yes/ obey my commands!
I'll put all my feelings into this cry!
Make sure you aim well. Don't take more than one shot.
Sometimes I have to be a little mean.
Then I know you can do this/ little Hisoutensoku!
I like a good shout once in a while!
...It's the style on Earth to shout here/ right?
I'm sure you have this well in hand/ Hisoutensoku.
I don't know/ this weapon seems pretty dangerous...
I suppose it's fine for now though.
A humanoid weapon... With this/ I'll be...
I think it wants to attack!
This is the perfect chance to attack.
Knock them down right this instant!
I wish I could bring this back to the moon with me.
Now's our chance! Do a good job!
You're an interesting doll/ aren't you? Go. Do it.
Do it like we planned! Hisoutensoku/ activate!
You can attack without worry now.
You're in the perfect position/ Hisoutensoku.
Wow/ it moved to defend all by itself!
Don't push yourself too much/ okay?
I'm surprised how well you're doing/ Hisoutensoku!
Such a sturdy treasure you are.
Always knew you had it in ya/ Hisoutensoku!
Looks like there's nothing to worry about!
Now that's what I call durability.
I think we can trust you with this.
Oh/ no! Hisoutensoku is in danger!
Hey! Be more careful while you're fighting!
Wow/ sparks are kinda going everywhere!
Keep trying! Just a little longer!
You're hurt. Please don't force yourself.
Hisoutensoku is more durable than that!
Oh no! It doesn't hurt/ does it/ Hisoutensoku?
Come on! I know you've got more guts than that!
It got hit/ but it should still be okay!
Are you okay? Does it hurt anywhere?
That won't be a problem at all!
Be careful not to hurt yourself too much/ okay?
Don't rely on your durability too much!
Whoa! You've gotta be more careful!
Huh/ so it can do that too!
Now isn't that a sight to see?
It can really move/ despite its size.
That's amazing! And it's so big/ too!
Hmm. Now wasn't that a slick dodge?
That attack won't be an issue.
You're in a good position now.
The early bird gets the worm/ Hisoutensoku!
Look—the enemy is wide open now.
That's gonna be quite a repair job. Withdraw and stand by!
